versions.subject: feat: general updates and fixes
versions.detection:
selection_metadata:
    - Image|endswith: '\wsudo.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'wsudo.exe'
    - Description: 'Windows sudo utility'
    - ParentImage|endswith: '\wsudo-bridge.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '-u System'
        - '-uSystem'
        - '-u TrustedInstaller'
        - '-uTrustedInstaller'
        - ' --ti '
condition: 1 of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\wsudo.exe" OR OriginalFileName="wsudo.exe" OR Description="Windows sudo utility" OR ParentImage="*\\wsudo-bridge.exe" OR CommandLine IN ("*-u System*", "*-uSystem*", "*-u TrustedInstaller*", "*-uTrustedInstaller*", "* --ti *")
